topic: Superlatives: Largest, Longest, Highest and Smallest (India and World)
description: This topic is a factual collection of major superlatives of India and the world. It provides details of the largest, longest, highest, and smallest geographical locations, structures, and facts, which are highly crucial for rapid revision and competitive exam preparation.

sections.title: Largest, Longest, and Highest in India
sections.description: Major superlatives related to the geography and infrastructure of India.

important_facts.fact: The Largest State in India by area is Rajasthan, whereas by population, it is Uttar Pradesh.
The Longest River in India is the Ganga (Ganges), with a total length of 2525 km.
The Highest Dam in India is the Tehri Dam, located on the Bhagirathi River in Uttarakhand.
The Longest Dam in India is the Hirakud Dam, built across the Mahanadi River in Odisha.
The Largest Desert in India is the Thar Desert, primarily located in the state of Rajasthan.
The Longest National Highway in India is NH 44, which runs from Srinagar in the north to Kanyakumari in the south.

sections.title: Largest, Longest, and Highest in the World
sections.description: The most prominent and massive geographical and physical features at the global level.

important_facts.fact: The Longest River in the World is the Nile River, which flows through the African continent.
The Largest River in the World by water drainage area and volume is the Amazon River, located in South America.
The Largest Ocean in the World is the Pacific Ocean.
The Largest Hot Desert in the World is the Sahara Desert, spreading across North Africa.
The Largest Continent in the World is Asia, ranking first in both total land area and population.
The Tallest Statue in the World is the Statue of Unity, standing at a height of 182 meters, located in Gujarat, India.

sections.title: Smallest in India and the World
sections.description: Details of the smallest states, countries, and geographical entities in India and the world.

important_facts.fact: The Smallest State in India by area is Goa, while the smallest state by population is Sikkim.
The Smallest Country in the World by both land area and population is Vatican City.
The Smallest Continent in the World is Australia, which is also referred to as the Island Continent.
The Smallest Ocean in the World is the Arctic Ocean.
The Smallest Bird in the World is the Bee Hummingbird.
